sanskrit_verse: राजदैवोपघातेन पण्ये दोषम् उपागते । हानिर् विक्रेतुर् एवासौ याचितस्याप्रयच्छतः ॥
transliteration: rājadaivopaghātena paṇye doṣam upāgate | hānir vikretur evāsau yācitasyāprayacchataḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When merchandise is damaged by force majeure or sovereign interference, the loss falls upon the seller if he withholds delivery after solicitation.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the sovereign domain but does not absolve individual capacity to act
Causation includes both natural and sovereign disruptions as valid pramāṇas
Capacity-based responsibility requires fulfillment of transactional integrity regardless of external disturbance
Restoration logic demands realignment of possession and intent without punitive consequence
Consciousness alignment necessitates completion of contractual dharma even under disruptive conditions
executable_legal_axioms: IF transaction occurs AND sovereign or divine event disrupts goods THEN seller retains risk until delivery is completed
IF buyer solicits delivery AND seller withholds due to damage THEN seller assumes full liability for non-delivery
IF contract exists THEN enforceability persists through all levels of daivic or rajasic disruption
IF seller fails to complete transaction post-disruption THEN restoration protocol activates to ensure asset reconciliation
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating commercial disputes involving acts of God or state intervention, the Supreme Court must affirm that contractual obligations remain binding. Liability shifts to the party capable of fulfilling the agreement, prioritizing transactional continuity over exemption claims.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa acknowledges rajadaiva as a causal factor yet assigns sequential duty based on capacity. The seller's retention of control implies responsibility. No punitive measure applies; rather, completion restores balance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate asset reconciliation between parties via neutral escrow mechanism
Assign compensatory value transfer aligned with original transactional intent
Reinstate trade relationship through guided mediation ensuring future compliance readiness
Verify seller’s operational capacity post-event before reactivating marketplace privileges
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling affirms Dharma as restoration, not retribution. Sovereign events do not negate individual capacity nor dissolve transactional truth. Consciousness alone adjudicates reality.
